claim: A door that rises is a sector with no height at rest, so its own walls are never drawn while it is shut: the leaf a player sees is the upper band of each NEIGHBOUR's wall onto it. Paint the leaf's tile on the neighbours' sides of the two portal edges; a tile painted on the door sector's own walls is drawn nowhere.
evidence: projects/cold-store, 2026-11-26: tile 495 on the door sector's walls was refused by the rule wall-tile-is-drawn-somewhere (one-sided wall in a zero-height sector draws nothing); painted on the passage's and the hall's side of the door's edges, the frame shows a metal leaf
bloodmap.render_slots: which band the renderer draws each wall tile on
projects/signal-box: rule warning on tile 170 until both sides were painted; frames/mech-gate/pairs.png shows the boards rising
use: After program.compile(): bloodmap.doors.hang_leaf(layout, door, tile, ("west", passage), ("east", hall)) paints the leaf on each neighbour's side (doors.rising_door makes the door room). The gate names the mistake as wall-tile-is-drawn-somewhere.
